{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Bush fulfilled a campaign promise and signed legislation to clean up more of the abandoned and polluted industrial sites known as brownfields.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Bush Administration has restored more than 1,000 brownfields to usable condition, which is more than were restored in the previous seven years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Prioritizing cleanup of brownfields encourages growth on existing sites and thus preserves greenfields and undeveloped land.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Cleanup of brownfields opens usable land for small businesses and residents in hundreds of communities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Cleanup of brownfields creates thousands of jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for efforts to revitalize urban neighborhoods, both aesthetically and economically.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush's commitment to national parks is producing results: parks are better managed, better funded, and better protected.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President Bush has been fulfilling a campaign promise to address the $4.9 billion maintenance backlog plaguing the National Park system.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will continue to support President Bush's approach to improving national parks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will move forward with common-sense management reforms that maximize visitor satisfaction and protect and conserve the parks' natural resources for future generations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for President Bush's Clear Skies proposal, which is the most aggressive Presidential initiative in history to reduce power plant emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Clear Skies, through a proven cap-and-trade system, will reduce by 70 percent emissions of sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and mercury.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The market-based policies in Clear Skies, along with a 90 percent cut in pollution from diesel vehicles, will help states meet new, more stringent standards to protect public health.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President's plan also provides regulatory certainty, enabling power plants to install state-of-the-art pollution control technologies.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These steps will lead to significant environmental improvements while ensuring a reliable, affordable electricity supply and keeping America's coal industry strong.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
